key_takeaways: 상용 텍스트 에디터의 성능 및 기능적 한계와 커스텀 제작 동기

en.title: Fine, I'll Build My Own Text Editor
en.hook: A journey into building a custom text editor from scratch to overcome the constraints of existing tools.
key_takeaways: Motivations for departing from commercial text editors in favor of a bespoke solution
Core engine architecture covering text buffer management and rendering mechanics
Maximizing productivity and technical growth through custom-tailored developer tools

zh.title: 好吧，我自己来做文本编辑器
zh.hook: 摆脱现有编辑器的局限，从零开始打造自定义文本编辑器的旅程与核心架构设计
key_takeaways: 放弃现有商业编辑器转而自研的核心动机
涵盖文本缓冲区管理与渲染机制的编辑器核心架构设计
通过量身定制开发工具实现个人生产力与技术的双重提升
